notes: ⚡ Tuckii v1.4.3 — The Speed Update: much faster search (waits until you stop typing), smart image caching so covers load instantly and scroll is smooth, faster app startup with a trimmed splash screen and a much smaller optimized app. 🧠 Smart Save: saving a link you already have no longer creates duplicates — Tuckii refreshes its details and keeps your tags, notes and collection. ↩️ Undo Delete: no more confirmation popups — deleting is instant, and a black UNDO bar at the bottom lets you restore a link (with everything intact) within a few seconds.
